page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g7ne.12xlarge is an x86_64 general-purpose compute instance belonging to the Enhanced family. Built on KVM virtualization, it provides 48 dedicated vCPUs driven by an Intel Xeon 8369HB processor clocked at 3.3 GHz. The instance is provisioned with 192.0 GB of system memory, maintaining a balanced 1:4 allocation ratio of 4.0 GB RAM per virtual processor core.

Network performance is anchored by a high-throughput 40 Gbps baseline network bandwidth, accommodating data-intensive communications. The instance does not include integrated local storage or dedicated hardware accelerators, relying entirely on network-attached cloud storage solutions for persistent disk volumes.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the balanced CPU-to-memory ratio provides dense resource consolidation without paying premiums for idle specialized silicon or unused local disks. The high network bandwidth allows for efficient distributed communication. The configuration is well suited for large enterprise applications, scalable web tiers, backend microservices architectures, data analytics pipelines, and distributed in-memory caching systems.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g7ne.12xlarge is an x86_64 general-purpose virtual server from the Enhanced instance family, powered by the KVM hypervisor. It is configured with 48 dedicated vCPUs based on the 3.3 GHz Intel Xeon 8369HB processor and provides 192.0 GB of memory, preserving a standard 1:4 core-to-memory ratio with 4.0 GB per vCPU. The instance features a substantial 40 Gbps baseline network throughput to support high-bandwidth inter-node communication. It contains no local storage and no GPU accelerators, necessitating remote block storage for operating system and data volumes. The resource profile provides a cost-efficient blend of dedicated compute capacity and balanced memory allocation. This setup fits enterprise application serving, containerized microservices clusters, batch processing, and distributed database or cache nodes.
